learning_outcomes.text: Explain the basic concepts of quality management and the DMAIC process.
Use statistical terminology and basic statistical concepts.
Analyze variability in processes and interpret control charts.
Apply control charts for variables and attributes to determine whether processes are under control.
Perform process capability analysis (PCA) and evaluate process performance.
Develop process improvement suggestions using advanced control charts (CUSUM, EWMA).
Explain acceptance sampling techniques and apply them in quality assurance processes.

syllabus_topics: Terminology, DMAIC (Define, Measure, Analyse, Improve, Control)
Introduction to Variability and Control Diagrams
Control Charts for Variables (x-r control charts)
Control Charts for Variables (x-S control charts)
Control Charts for Attributes (n, np control charts)
Control Charts for Attributes (c, u control charts)
assessment_rules: The final success grade is determined by the contribution of in-term activities and the final exam grade. The Midterm Examination contributes 40% to the final grade, and the Final Examination contributes 60%.
bibliography: Montgomery, D. C. (2019). Introduction to Statistical Quality Control. Wiley.
Besterfield, D. H. (2013). Quality Control. Pearson.
Pyzdek, T., & Keller, P. (2014). The Six Sigma Handbook. McGraw-Hill Education.
Oakland, J. S. (2014). Statistical Process Control. Routledge.
